events.label: planning
events.text: Predecessor Line 6 conceived as pan-handle loop including Line 7 sections.

evidence.quote: Line 6 was originally conceived in 1973 as a pan-handle shaped route

events.label: founding
events.text: Line 6 dissolved; its western section became Line 7.

evidence.quote: In 1983 Line 6 was dissolved into two distinct lines .

events.text: Planned Line 6 section revised as Line 7 eastern extension, forming current alignment.

evidence.quote: By 1993 the planned section of Line 6 heading to Coking Plant complex was revised as an eastern extension of Line 7

events.text: Plans for Line 7 reported in the media; construction scheduled to begin by end of year

evidence.quote: January 8 , 2008 : Plans for Line 7 reported in the media

events.text: Line 7 route plan with 23 stations received regulatory approval.

evidence.quote: Oct . 30 , 2008 : Line 7 route plan with 23 stations receive regulatory approval

events.text: Construction on Line 7 announced to begin in late August 2009

evidence.quote: July 19 , 2009 : Construction on Line 7 announced to begin in late August 2009
Nov . 6 , 2009 : Commencement of Line 7 construction deferred to 2010

events.text: Construction reportedly began along Guangqu Road section.

evidence.quote: Jan . 19 , 2010 : Construction reportedly begun along Guangqu Road

events.text: Line 7 design revised from 6-car to 8-car trains.

evidence.quote: In 2013 , planners revised the design of Line 7 from using the standard 6 car trains to 8 car trains

events.text: Line 7 Phase I test runs began.

evidence.quote: It started test runs in September 2014

events.text: Phase I full operations began, excluding Shuangjing and Fatou stations.

evidence.quote: Dec . 28 , 2014 : Operations of Phase I of Line 7 begin

events.text: Fatou infill station of Phase I opened.

evidence.quote: Dec . 30 , 2018 : An infill station of Phase I , Fatou station was opened

events.text: Phase II eastern extension opened, excluding Universal Resort station.

evidence.quote: Dec . 28 , 2019 : Operations of Phase II of Line 7 begin

events.text: Shuangjing infill station of Phase I opened.

evidence.quote: Dec . 28 , 2019 : Operations of Phase II of Line 7 begin
An infill station of Phase I , Shuangjing station was opened

undated_mentions: Line 7 later revised westward to terminate at Beijing West railway station.
Planning Committee approved revised 21-station plan ending at Jiaohuachang.
Early 1990s: space set aside at Beijing West station for future Line 7 interchange.
